text:
You're not unlucky. You're weak in one of five things.

Game. How you talk. How you move. How you seduce.

Money. Proof you control resources.

Muscles. Discipline and testosterone, visible.

Frame. Your mental rules. The cage nobody breaks.

Status. Who knows your name.

Every man above you is strong in at least four of these. You're strong in maybe one.

Pick that one. Make it a weapon. This month. That changes everything.
caption:
Male value is simple. Game, money, muscles, frame, status. Pick one. Build discipline and self improvement in that area starting today.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
